_note: Pipeline stage map and router contract (design, not executable yet). Every catalogue ID appears exactly once as a primary stage; 'also' lists other stages where it plays a role. 'components' are tools/models, not catalogue techniques. Generated view: docs/flow/index.html via scripts/build_flow.py. Design: docs/architecture/ROUTER_DESIGN.md.

lanes.title: Ingestion (offline, per document)
lanes.subtitle: Runs once per document version in the worker

lanes.title: Question answering (online, per question)
lanes.subtitle: Runs per request in the API under a latency budget

stages.title: Upload and intake
stages.goal: Accept the corpus safely and keep an unchangeable version of every file.

stages.title: Extraction
stages.goal: Turn each file into text, layout, tables and images with exact positions.
metrics: Character error rate vs gold pages

stages.title: Normalise and anchor
stages.goal: Clean text reversibly and create stable source anchors (Unicode code-point offsets).

stages.title: Chunking
stages.goal: Split each document region with the policy that fits its structure.
components: Tokenizer of the selected embedding model

stages.title: Representations and knowledge structures
stages.goal: Build extra views of the corpus: summaries, questions, context, trees, graphs.
metrics: Graph extraction precision on gold triples

stages.title: Embedding and indexing
stages.goal: Encode chunks and build the search indexes the query side can use.
components: Dense embedder (bge-m3, qwen3-embedding, embeddinggemma, nomic-embed-text, paid APIs)
metrics: Recall@k / nDCG@k on dev set per embedder

stages.title: Knowledge preload and caches
stages.goal: Prepare preloaded context for small stable corpora and serving-side caches.
metrics: Answer quality vs RAG on same set

stages.title: Cache check
stages.goal: Reuse a previous answer only when scope, versions and intent truly match.
components: Exact key: scope + versions + normalised question + pipeline config
Partitioned semantic index of past questions

stages.title: Understand and route the question
stages.goal: Decide what kind of question this is and which path to take.
components: Source catalogue (docs, graph, SQL, web, CAG)

stages.title: Query transformation
stages.goal: Rewrite or expand the question only when it helps retrieval.
components: Small local chat model for rewrites

stages.title: Retrieval
stages.goal: Fetch candidate evidence from the indexes and sources the route allows.

stages.title: Fusion and selection
stages.goal: Merge candidate lists and remove duplicates without fake score comparisons.

stages.title: Reranking
stages.goal: Re-score the top candidates with a stronger, slower model when worth it.

stages.title: Context building
stages.goal: Expand, compress and order evidence to fit the model's budget.

stages.title: Generation
stages.goal: Write a structured, cited answer with the chosen model.
components: Provider registry (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Kimi, LM Studio, vLLM)

stages.title: Check and correct
stages.goal: Verify claims against evidence; retry, abstain or answer.

stages.title: Agentic orchestration (wraps Q1–Q8)
stages.goal: Let a bounded agent loop over tools for multi-step questions.

stages.title: Evaluation and feedback
stages.goal: Score every run and turn results into router training data.

routers.decides: Which extractor per file/page (text layer, layout, OCR, vision LLM).
routers.metric: Character error rate and table accuracy vs gold pages; cost per page

routers.decides: Which chunking policy per region (C01–C21) and its size/overlap.
features: structure type (markdown, html, json, code, table, prose)
routers.metric: Downstream Recall@k of the chosen chunker vs the best chunker for that region type

routers.decides: Which representations and indexes to build (dense model, sparse, graph, RAPTOR, CAG preload).
routers.metric: Quality on dev questions per extra index vs its build and storage cost

routers.decides: Main path: cache, no retrieval, document RAG, graph, SQL, web, CAG or agentic; and which generator model.
routers.metric: Route accuracy vs oracle, regret, and abstention correctness

routers.decides: None, rewrite, multi-query, decomposition, step-back, HyDE or RAG-fusion.
routers.metric: Recall@k gain over no transform minus added latency

routers.decides: Which retrievers, k per branch, filters and fusion method.
routers.default: hybrid dense + FTS, k=20 each, RRF
routers.metric: Recall@k and nDCG@k vs best fixed retriever set

routers.decides: Rerank or not (and which), context expansion, compression and final k.
routers.metric: nDCG@5 and evidence-in-context recall vs added latency

routers.decides: Accept, retry with another route, or abstain.
routers.default: accept if all citations resolve, else one retry, then abstain
routers.metric: Final faithfulness, correct-abstention rate, retries per answer
